label: Redis Streams consumer-group metrics
info: A singleton, bounded collector for Redis Streams consumer groups. Configure REDIS_STREAM_GROUPS_JSON or flow.redisStreamGroups manually, select the Redis config node, then deploy. Do not run this collector in every worker pod: it reads global Redis group state.

name: Manual bounded inventory, throttle, and export labels
info: Set REDIS_STREAM_GROUPS_JSON or flow.redisStreamGroups to the stream/group list. REDIS_STREAM_METRICS_MAX_PAIRS defaults to 500. Keep the delay rate high enough that one polling cycle finishes before the next one starts.
